items.quote: 23:2 And Sarah died in Kirjatharba; the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan
items.claim: The text says Sarah died at Kirjatharba, which it identifies with Hebron in the land of Canaan.

items.quote: Kirjatharba; the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan
items.claim: The text treats Kirjatharba as another name for Hebron and places it in the land of Canaan.

items.quote: and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.
items.claim: The text says Abraham came to mourn and weep for Sarah after she died.
Not verified, from model-prior only: the verse number and wording suggest this is Genesis 23:2 in the King James Version. The document does not name the book or translation.
